why: Knight Destrier datasheet (GW faction pack, Wahapedia, NR): W 18 and "DAMAGED: 1-6 WOUNDS REMAINING ... While this model has 1-6 wounds remaining". Sanctuary does not change W, so damaged '1-6' with W 18 matches.

"If this model is equipped with a thundershock spear and a bellatus reaper chainsword"; both 6-bigs Destriers (x2) carry "Questoris heavy stubber, Titanic feet, Chastiser gatling cannon, Frag bombard" (NR p2), so the condition is never met.

"Each time this unit is selected to make a Normal or Advance move": these are move types of Move Units in the Movement phase (core 09.02 "The active player moves their units"), so your Movement phase only.

"subtract 4 from this model's Objective Control characteristic and each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll" while it "has 1-6 wounds remaining": all attacks, -1 to hit, -4 OC.

"Each time this model makes a ranged attack that targets the closest eligible target": the Errant is TITANIC, and Fire Overwatch targets "One friendly unengaged unit (excluding TITANIC units)", so its only ranged attacks are in your Shooting phase.
Knight Crusader W 26 (Wahapedia, NR) and the faction-pack errata for the Crusader's Damaged section: "While this model has 1-9 wounds remaining, subtract 5 ...". Band 1-9 matches.
NR prints "Errant's Duty (Bondsman)" and the Bondsman rule says these abilities are "tagged with the word 'Bondsman'".
"Each time this model makes a ranged attack that targets the closest eligible target, add 1 to the Hit roll": ranged, condition and +1 to hit are all the rule's own words.

"While this model has 1-9 wounds remaining, subtract 5 from this model's Objective Control characteristic and each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll": all attacks, -1 to hit, -5 OC.

Bondsman: "select one friendly Armiger model within 12\" ... that Armiger model is affected", so needs ARMIGER is right; "ranged weapons equipped by that model have the [ASSAULT] ability" is the note (the Advance re-roll is left out as it is not about attacks). No ARMIGER is in 6-bigs, so it shows nowhere.
"Once per battle, at the start of any phase": the turn has "a series of five phases" (core 07.02) and nothing limits it to your turn, so all five phases, either turn.

"Once per turn, when you target this model with a stratagem" names no phase; stratagems can target Canis Rex in every phase of either turn, matching Direct the Slaughter / Will of the Hive Mind elsewhere in the app.
NR Models box: "1x Canis Rex  Freedom's Hand, Las-impulsor, Questoris multi-laser" and "1x Sir Hekhtur  Close combat weapon, Hekhtur's pistol"; gear lines and the 7 weapon rows match exactly.

where: 4-megas-and-a-destrier · Cerastus Knight Lancer · Damaged: 1-10 Wounds Remaining
why: Cerastus Knight Lancer datasheet (GW faction pack): W 28 and "DAMAGED: 1-10 WOUNDS REMAINING ... While this model has 1-10 wounds remaining". Matches.

where: 4-megas-and-a-destrier · Cerastus Knight Atrapos · Bringer of Justice
why: Bringer of Justice is listed under ENHANCEMENTS of the Freeblade Company detachment (GW faction pack) and in the Atrapos' NR Options ("Bringer of Justice, Atrapos lascutter, ...").
NR prints "Atrapos' Duty (Bondsman)" and the GW datasheet "Atrapos' Duty (Bondsman)".

"Each time this model makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, add 1 to the Hit roll. If that target is TITANIC or TOWERING, add 1 to the Wound roll as well." The footnote says exactly that, for all attacks.

"each time the bearer makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Hit roll": NR did not apply it (WS stays 3+), so it belongs in a footnote. The +2 A is already in NR's melee profiles (A 8/14 vs datasheet 6/12, marked "(Bringer of Justice)") and the footnote rightly does not add it again.

"While this model has 1-10 wounds remaining, subtract 5 from this model's Objective Control characteristic and each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll": all attacks, -1 to hit, -5 OC.

Bondsman affects only "one friendly Armiger model", hence needs ARMIGER; "each time that model makes an attack that targets a TITANIC or TOWERING model, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll" is the condition and note. No ARMIGER is in this list.

NR: "1x Cerastus Knight Atrapos  Bringer of Justice, Atrapos lascutter, Graviton singularity cannon" (the enhancement is not a weapon). The lascutter appears twice because NR prints a "(ranged)" and a "(melee)" pair of profiles; they sit in separate tables.
NR prints "Lancer's Duty (Bondsman)" and the GW datasheet "Lancer's Duty (Bondsman)".
NR: "1x Cerastus Knight Lancer  Cerastus shock lance", with one ranged profile and "strike"/"sweep" melee profiles. That matches the 3 weapon rows and the single gear line.

"In your Movement phase, if this model Remains Stationary, until the end of the turn, ranged weapons ... have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]": it is set in your Movement phase and its ranged-weapon effect is used in your Shooting phase. A TITANIC model can't Fire Overwatch, and the effect ends with your turn.
Hunter's Eye is under ENHANCEMENTS of the Freeblade Company detachment (GW faction pack) and in the Crusader's NR Options ("Hunter's Eye, Avenger gatling cannon, ...").
NR prints "Crusader's Duty (Bondsman)" and Wahapedia "Crusader's Duty (Bondsman)".

"In your Movement phase, if this model Remains Stationary, until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by this model have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability": the condition, the duration and the note are the rule's own words.

Bondsman affects only "one friendly Armiger model", hence needs ARMIGER; "each time that model makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Hit roll" means ranged attacks get +1 to hit. No ARMIGER is in this list. Hunter's Eye is not repeated in any Crusader footnote.

NR: "1x Knight Crusader  Hunter's Eye, Avenger gatling cannon, Heavy flamer, Titanic feet, Stormspear rocket pod, Meltagun, Rapid-fire battlecannon and Questoris heavy stubber". All 7 weapons are on the one model line.

Same Thundercharge condition ("equipped with a thundershock spear and a bellatus reaper chainsword"); this Destrier has "Sanctuary, Questoris heavy stubber, Titanic feet, Chastiser gatling cannon, Frag bombard" (NR p6), so it does not apply.
Sanctuary is under ENHANCEMENTS of the Freeblade Company detachment (GW faction pack) and in the Destrier's NR Options ("Sanctuary, Questoris heavy stubber, ...").
"The bearer has a 5+ invulnerable save." NR did not apply it (InSv still "5+*", ranged only), so the When targeted line is needed, and it says what the rule says.
